description: Source code for a PWM driver module in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, including initialization, configuration, duty cycle control, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: GetTimeBaseFromChannel
methods.description: Returns the timer base register associated with a given PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_Init
methods.description: Initializes PWM channels based on provided configuration, sets up timers, and installs ISRs if notifications are supported.

methods.name: Pwm_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes PWM channels and timers, disables notifications, and resets module state.

methods.name: Pwm_SetDutyCycle
methods.description: Sets the duty cycle for a specific PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty
methods.description: Configures period and duty cycle for a PWM channel if enabled.

methods.name: Pwm_DisableNotification
methods.description: Disables interrupt notifications for a PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_EnableNotification
methods.description: Enables interrupt notifications for a PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_Isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling PWM timer compare events.

methods.name: Pwm_SetOutputToIdle
methods.description: Sets PWM output to idle state for a channel.

methods.name: Pwm_GetOutputState
methods.description: Returns the current output state of a PWM channel (not fully implemented).

methods.name: Pwm_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Provides version information for the PWM module.
